sources.title: Lumo: Privacy-first AI assistant where chats stay confidential
sources.snippet: An AI assistant should empower you, not exploit you for your data. That's why we built Lumo: To bring you all the benefits of AI, without compromising your privacy and data security.

sources.title: Lumo (AI assistant) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Lumo is an online chatbot and personal assistant developed by Proton AG. The service saves chat histories in encrypted storage, and states that it does not employ user data for model training.
